 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Coastal Carolina Chanticleers (2-2) at Wisconsin Badgers (3-0)
 Madison, Wisconsin; Sunday, 8 p.m. EST
 BOTTOM LINE: Wisconsin will attempt to extend its three-game win streak with a victory over Coastal Carolina.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Wisconsin finished 24-11 overall a season ago while going 15-2 at home. The Badgers gave up 76.1 points per game while committing 17.2 fouls last season.
 Coastal Carolina went 19-13 overall last season while going 10-7 on the road. The Chanticleers averaged 73.3 points per game last season, 25.6 in the paint, 9.7 off of turnovers and 8.2 on fast breaks.
